item.title: Modular JavaScript with ES Modules
item.description: Remember when a complex JavaScript project was just one massive 4,000-line script.js file, or ten <script> tags dumped in your HTML hoping the global variables wouldn’t clash? :') Those days are thankfully behind us. With ES Modules (ESM), native modularity is supported directly by both modern browsers and runtime engines. item.description: Let’s talk about syntactic sugar that genuinely makes your day better. item.title: Essential Modern Array Methods
item.description: Back in my early programming days, whenever I needed to filter a list or transform items, I’d immediately write an index loop: for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) { ... } It works, sure. But it’s verbose, full of mutable state, and easy to introduce accidental off-by-one bugs. :') Modern JavaScript treats arrays as first-class citizens with built-in functional transformation methods.
